meta.title: ATHAR - Financing Advisor
meta.description: A digital financing advisor that reads financial standing from simulated banking data, applies affordability rules, compares offers by true cost, and explains every decision in Arabic - demo only.

footer.about: ATHAR is a demo platform for comparing consumer financing: code calculates and the model explains.
footer.disclaimer: Demo platform - rates are unverified and the final decision always belongs to the financing institution.
footer.transparency: Every number comes from a tested deterministic engine, and anything unverified or simulated is clearly labeled.

landing.heroTitle: Your financing decision, calculated and explained in Arabic
landing.heroSubtitle: ATHAR reads your financial position from simulated banking data, applies Saudi affordability rules through deterministic code, compares Islamic financing structures by their true cost, and explains every approval and rejection.
landing.honestyStrip: Simulated banking data · Offer rates are unverified · Not a financing offer
landing.stepsTitle: Four transparent stages, clear from start to finish

steps.label: Discover
steps.title: Customer data and request
steps.text: Choose a demo persona and give explicit consent to read simulated account data.

steps.label: Assess
steps.title: Define affordability
steps.text: Agents work in front of you: extracting salary and obligations and calculating installment headroom.

steps.label: Improve
steps.title: Compare offers
steps.text: Rank offers by true cost, with a clear reason for every approval or rejection and instant simulation.

steps.label: Deliver
steps.title: Decision and next step
steps.text: An explained recommendation, an advisor that only answers from engine results, and a tracked demo application.

trust.title: Numbers come from the engine, not the model
trust.text: Every riyal and ratio comes from tested deterministic functions. The language model explains only, with a guardrail behind it that blocks any number missing from engine results.

trust.title: Rate transparency
trust.text: Current catalog offers use preliminary rates marked "Unverified rate" until they are reviewed against official pages - and the badge never disappears silently.

trust.title: Explainability
trust.text: Affordability limits, rejection reasons in plain text, and "smallest change to open the path" suggestions - rejection is discussable, not silent.

docs.title: How it works
docs.lead: This page explains the architecture plainly: what is calculated, who explains it, and the limits of the demo.

idea.title: The idea
idea.text: ATHAR is not a comparison table - it is an agentic advisor that runs the journey for you: reads financial standing, matches every market offer, prices honestly, and explains every decision in Arabic across four stages: discover, assess, improve, deliver.

engine.title: Who calculates and who explains
engine.text: Every riyal, ratio, and eligibility decision comes from a tested deterministic engine. The language model only explains the results, and a numerical guardrail prevents it from mentioning any number missing from engine outputs - when a reply is blocked, the user sees that clearly.

data.title: Data path
data.text: Simulated Open Banking data -> financial profile extraction (salary, obligations) -> affordability limits -> matching and pricing every offer -> ranked and explained results. Replacing the mock provider with a licensed provider is a base-URL change, not a rebuild.

limits.title: Demo limits
items: Banking data is fully simulated - there is no connection to real banks.
All current offer rates are preliminary and not reviewed against official pages, and they are labeled accordingly.
Mobile OTP verification is simulated, not national identity verification.
Application submission is fully simulated - no request reaches any financing institution.
Encoded affordability rules need external review before any public use.
The platform is not a licensed financial service, and the final decision always belongs to the financing institution.

verification.title: Transparency and verification
verification.text: The "Unverified rate" badge means the number has not yet been reviewed against the institution's official page. Live verification coverage is shown on the status page.

status.title: Status
status.internalNote: Internal page - shows no secrets, only operating indicators.
status.activityNote: Aggregate numbers from current server memory only.
status.secretNote: The page shows booleans and counters only, and never exposes secret configuration values.

The feature will stay labeled as demo until there is a licensed and reviewed integration.
